cmsFields.title: RustDesk review: connection and build boundaries
cmsFields.subtitle: What does owning remote-desktop infrastructure change, and which endpoint responsibilities remain?
cmsFields.summary: RustDesk repository review of rendezvous and relay boundaries, native build dependencies and remote-access trust, without untested security assurances.
keyTakeaways: The application repository is not the same artifact as its rendezvous/relay server.
Native libraries, UI bridges and platform builds are part of the maintenance surface.
Self-hosted connectivity is not proof of endpoint authorization or complete security.
